question.text: Which of the following sections are, AT MINIMUM, required to be covered in the Annual Impact Report under SEBI's framework?

answer.text: Strategic Intent and Planning; Approach (baseline, past trend, etc.); Impact Score Card.
Strategic Intent and Planning; Governance Report; Auditor's Certificate.

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI AIR framework requires at least three sections: Strategic Intent and Planning (challenge, target, outcomes), Approach (baseline, past trend, implementation, SDG alignment, stakeholder feedback, risks), and Impact Score Card (metrics, narratives, validation). Governance Report and Auditor's Certificate are NOT AIR sections - they live elsewhere. The Trap: Option D's 'Auditor's Certificate' confuses AIR with financial audit output. Single-section answers (A, C) are incomplete. Cross-Exam Context: PDF chapter sample Q2 - direct recall. Also tested indirectly across XXIII Topic 7 (Reporting). Assessor's Pro-Tip: When drafting an AIR TOC, resist adding a separate 'Governance' section - governance data is disclosed under 91(C), not in the AIR. Keeping AIR tightly scoped to the three sections improves readability and avoids filing-rejection risk.
